recalls.summary: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2022 Sentra vehicles.  The driver's side cowl area may have a missing or improper seal, which can allow water to leak inside the vehicle and corrode electrical components.
Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2020-2022 Sentra vehicles.  The left and/or right tie rod may bend.
